candidates.name: IndoorGML
verified_facts: IndoorGML specifies an open data model and XML schema for indoor spatial information.
Its intentional focus is modelling indoor spaces for navigation purposes.
semantic_limits: Indoor navigation-space geometry is outside the evidentiary role of an external bare-earth parcel DTM and cannot validate parcel elevation results.

candidates.name: LandInfra / InfraGML
verified_facts: LandInfra and InfraGML cover land and civil-engineering infrastructure concepts including land features, survey equipment, observations, survey results, land division and terrain.
InfraGML provides GML encodings of the LandInfra conceptual model.
semantic_limits: A survey or land-division schema does not certify that a particular survey observation, parcel boundary or terrain height satisfies the required source-specific accuracy budget.
